name: muuri
description: Infinite responsive, sortable, filterable and draggable layouts

commits.message: fix: removed yarn and added package-lock.json
feat: disable index page and use docs as default
Clear packer rect store after each layout + simplify styles caching system.
Delete packer layout from temporary cache when it returns from the worker.
Update deps + fix broken arg parsing in gulpfile.js.
Fix bug: item variable missing in ItemDrag.
Add default safeZone value to the docs
Fix iOS sniffing to include iPadOS 13+.
Fix iOS dnd bug, autoscroll bug and layout bug.
Do not use default function parameters as it does not work in older (ES5) browsers.
Internal refactoring of animations and translate value caching.
Remove dragAutoScroll.syncAfterScroll option and refactor AutoScroller a bit.
Set AutoScroller smoothStop option to  by default.
Fix class removal issue after reparenting.
Fix bug: make drag scroll handler respect axis dragAxis.
Do not enforce display:block CSS rule.
Remove Muuri Queue mention from banner (merge into Muuri Emitter).
Rename slot -> rect in PackerProcessor splitRect method.
Update README + Make dragAxis option more strict.
Add ES Module build, Refactor AutoScroller a bit and update dependencies and reformat src files (Prettier's style changed a bit).
Initial TypeScript type definitions and internal API refactoring.
A bit of refactoring and fixing an edge-case with migration.
Refactor worker code to get bundle size down.
Remove yargs dep and use custom arg checker instead.
Fix/refactor tests and make necessary adjustments to code based on the issues found.
Expose default Packer instance so it can be modified/removed.

Too much refactoring (sorry). Faster item lookups by element. Faster sorting (in some cases). Deprecate the possibility to define layout.widht/height unit as string (only allow pixel values as numbers
Make grid.add() faster, a lot faster.
Async layout & other layout performance optimizations.
AutoScroller documentation + logic for handling large items.
Add support for using pointer as the drag auto scroll handle.
Only allow autoscrolling towards the drag direction.
Improve drag autoscroll & sort interplay, throttle autoscroll start checks.
Add acceleration/decelaration to AutoSctoller.smoothSpeed + AutoScroller performance tweaks.
Autoscroll performance update + avoid interrupting ongoing scroll.
Fix bug with scrolling non-overlapping element.
Initial working drag scroll (still needs more fine-tuning) + some refactoring to support the changes.
Refactor layoutAbort event and switch the argument order of layout's onFinish callback to make it more in line with the rest of the API.
Remove styles without value from visible/hiddenStyles.
